The user wants me to classify the relationship between the blind consensus responses and the book's entry on "Ship" according to the specific JSON schema.
**core_relation: REFINED**  
The book preserves the consensus’s central referent (the Church as a vessel carrying believers safely through the world) but materially broadens its extension. The consensus treats “ship” primarily as the ecclesial community (Barque of Peter / Noah’s ark typology). The book identifies ship as any organized kingdom, city, or state riding upon the sea of peoples, with Christ as its true Head when He boards it. This category includes the Church as one possible case but also admits (and the printed citations emphasize) worldly polities such as Tyre and Babylon. The common-view note still acknowledges the traditional Church reading, yet the entry itself shifts the primary referent to the broader political entity.

**extension_relation: REFINED**  
The book narrows the negative commercial readings (Tyre, Babylon, ships of Tarshish) to the primary sense while retaining them as valid examples of the new category. It also adds the 1 Corinthians 12 / Ephesians 2 imagery of the Church as a new “city” or “kingdom” built on the sea of peoples, which the consensus treats only as a secondary or devotional application. The book therefore excludes some purely devotional or individual-journey readings that the consensus admits, but it does not displace the 1 Peter 3 / Luke 5 / Gospel-boat material; it simply subordinates it to the larger political typology.
